run_binarize_multilingual_data: run the binarize script to preprocess multilingual translation data using sentencepiece BPE and fairseq-preprocess
encode_spm_direction: encode raw parallel corpus files for a language direction using sentencepiece BPE tokenization
binarize_fairseq_data: binarize BPE-encoded parallel data into fairseq databin format with source and target language dictionaries
get_data_size_raw: get the line count of a raw parallel corpus file using wc -l
load_langs_file: load a list of language codes from a text file with one language per line
